title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(山本知仁研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Yamamoto Tomohito)
educationalGoal: In this capstone project, students will conduct research activities related to IT systems based on the knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology that they have learned so far. Through these activities, students acquire the abilities needed for identifying a problem, designing the project, and implementing an IT system. Additionally, students will acquire generic abilities related to communicating with others, and evaluating results.
advice: Recently, various intelligent IT systems have come into use all over the world. In this project, students learn the methods of collecting and analyzing data for such systems, as well as methods for implementing them. Specific research areas focused in this project are as follows: 1. Human interface and communication. 2. Virtual reality and mixed reality. 3. Human-computer interaction. 4. Artificial intelligence and Data Science. Students will select a topics from one of these research areas and pursue it as they work to acquire the abilities needed for developing valuable IT systems. Moreover, students will acquire communication skills through academic meetings and conferences.
books: Required Materials will be provided in the class.
requiredKnowledge: Major achievements are the results of small and daily achievements. Students are recommended to conduct self-checking every quarter.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set a project schedule based on a set research topic goal.
Be able to set an appropriate approach or method for the project.
Be able to acquire the IT knowledge and skills needed for proceeding with the project.
Be able to deal with the problems that will occur in the analysis and design process.
Be able to evaluate the result from subjective and objective viewpoints for better understanding.
